## Appearance

Sarah is a small person who dresses in shabby black clothing. Her hat is selected for its durable qualities rather than for vain adornment.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055)_

## History

Sarah was forbidden by her father from marrying Luther Wallace twenty years ago because Luther was poor, leaving her to whitewash an old duckhouse every spring in case it ever proved useful. Years later, she rescued [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) after the girl became stuck on her duckhouse roof while trying to peek into her pantry window. After accepting Anne's apology, Sarah negotiated the sale of her old willow-ware platter for twenty-five dollars and revealed that she was planning to get married.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P2](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0002), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P4](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0004), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P5](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0005), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P6](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0006), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P7](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0007), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P8](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0008), +25 more_
